tablet.title: Tablet {number}
tablet.description: The battery sensor is the one from the Home Assistant companion app installed on the tablet: enable it in App Settings, Sensors. The output is the one powering the charger.

sicurezza.title: Safeguards
sicurezza.description: Below the critical level the charger runs regardless. If the sensor reports nothing for the given hours the charger is switched on: without a trustworthy reading, leaving it off means ending up with a flat tablet and a black screen.
